tools.name: list_merchants
tools.description: List the Adyen merchant accounts this API credential can reach (id, name, company, status, capture delay)

tools.name: get_merchant
tools.description: Get one Adyen merchant account by merchant ID (name, company, status, settlement currency)

merchant_id.description: Adyen merchant account ID, the merchant account name from the Customer Area (e.g. YourCompanyECOM)

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: List the stores under one Adyen merchant account (id, description, status, address, merchant reference)

merchant_id.description: Adyen merchant account ID whose stores to list

reference.description: Optional store reference to filter by

tools.name: list_payment_methods
tools.description: List the payment methods configured on one Adyen merchant account, optionally scoped to one store

merchant_id.description: Adyen merchant account ID whose payment method settings to list

store_id.description: Optional store ID to scope the payment methods to

needs_review: SHAPE-PROOF RESULT (real run, 2026-09-12, 1 iteration): verbatim overall line 'adyen  AUTH_WALL  proven=0 authwall=5 ambiguous=0 failed=0 inconclusive=0 skipped=0'. The Management API answered the test call, all four tools AND the deliberately bogus control path with the byte-identical 401 {"type":"https://docs.adyen.com/errors/unauthorized","title":"Unauthorized","status":401,"errorCode":"00_401"} (control_match: error_code), so every result carries path_unproven. Host, TLS, base_url https://management-live.adyen.com and Adyen's own structured error envelope are proven; NO PATH IS PROVEN BY THIS RUN. The four /v3 routes rest on documentary provenance from the Management API v3 reference alone. Adyen rejects the credential before routing, so no probe hint or path tweak can move this off AUTH_WALL blind: terminal at one iteration, not a defect to iterate on.

LIVE vs TEST HOST SPLIT, UNRESOLVED AND OWNER-FACING. base_url is pinned to the LIVE Management API (management-live.adyen.com). Adyen splits every API by environment: Management is management-live.adyen.com vs management-test.adyen.com, Checkout is api.checkout.adyen.com vs checkout-test.adyen.com. A test-environment API key returns 401 against the live host and vice versa, so a credential saved under this type works against exactly one of them. Worse, the vault entry (services/auth/config/integrationTypeRegistry.js:2514) has testEndpoint https://checkout-test.adyen.com/v71/paymentMethods, i.e. the TEST Checkout host, so a credential that PASSES the vault connection test can 401 on every tool here. Fixing this needs either an environment field on the vault entry or a second credential type: an owner call, not a silent edit.

Scaffolded base_url and test block REPLACED (auth left exactly as scaffolded). The scaffold's test was POST /v71/paymentMethods on the Checkout API, which is a payment-session-shaped POST carrying a body and does not exist on the Management API host. This wave's read tools are all Management API v3 GETs, so the test block is now GET /v3/me (Get API credential details), the cheapest credential-scoped read on that host.

Auth header case kept as scaffolded, 'x-API-key'; Adyen's docs spell it X-API-Key. HTTP field names are case-insensitive (RFC 9110 5.1) so this should be equivalent, but note that an AUTH_WALL proof does NOT prove the header was parsed at all: the identical 401 at the control path is what an unrecognised header would also produce. Only a real key settles it.

The Management API's merchantId path parameter is the merchant account name from the Customer Area, which is exactly what the vault's merchant_account field collects. The tools take merchant_id as an input rather than reading the vault field, so one credential can reach several merchant accounts; whether the stored value is accepted verbatim as merchantId is unverified blind.

READ-ONLY by design: no tool is marked write:true and every request is a GET. Adyen's payment-taking surface (Checkout POST /v71/payments, /v71/sessions) and Management's own mutations (store and payment-method creation) are deliberately ABSENT: they move money or change a live merchant configuration and need their own approval design.

pageSize is clamped 20..100 per Adyen's documented maximum of 100. The pageNumber upper clamp of 1000 is OURS, not a documented Adyen limit: it exists only so a runaway input cannot render an absurd query value.
